description: Create a new discount code. Supports percentage or fixed amount discounts with optional duration and usage limits.

amount.description: Discount amount — in cents for 'fixed' type (e.g. 1000 = $10.00), or percentage for 'percent' type (e.g. 20 = 20%)

code.description: The discount code customers will enter (e.g. 'SAVE20')

duration.description: How long the discount applies: 'once' (first payment only), 'repeating' (for N months), or 'forever' (default)

durationInMonths.description: Number of months the discount applies (required when duration is 'repeating')

isLimitedToProducts.description: If true, the discount only applies to specific variants (set via variantIds)

maxRedemptions.description: Maximum number of times this discount can be redeemed (0 = unlimited)

startsAt.description: When the discount becomes active (ISO 8601 format)

storeId.description: The store ID to create the discount in

variantIds.description: Array of variant IDs this discount applies to (requires isLimitedToProducts: true)

name: ls_create_discount
